description: Sector overlay for telecommunications service providers, internet services, wireless services, numbering resources, consumer codes, CRTC obligations, CASL, telemarketing, and telecom privacy/security documentation in Canada.

metadata.scope: Canada-only sector overlay controls for Telecommunications. Intended to be used with canada_core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis verified against official Canadian federal/provincial/territorial legal and regulatory sources available through 2026-08-30. Draft or proposed measures and enacted provisions not yet in force, and regulator requirements with future compliance or enforcement dates are not treated as operative compliance obligations. This starter pack is not legal advice and requires expert validation before production reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: CRTC Wireless Code and Internet Code amendments — Telecom Regulatory Policy 2026-43

rules.title: CRTC telecommunications regulatory evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for CRTC, Telecommunications Act, tariff, forbearance, registration, or telecom service provider evidence.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.
metadata.review_guidance: A qualified Canadian legal/compliance reviewer must confirm applicability, jurisdictional scope, provincial/territorial variations, legal sufficiency, and whether absence of textual evidence should be treated as non-compliance.
